title: ShortCutCommands
description: A Paper 1.21.4+ plugin to create in-game command shortcuts that forward to existing commands.
body:
Tired of typing long/boring commands? ShortcutCommands lets you create your own quick aliases for any command in the game.

**Examples:**

Turn /pardon into /unban

Turn /gamemode creative into /gmc

Once you set up a shortcut, you can use it instantly — no server reload required. Shortcuts also respect the original command’s permissions, so if someone can’t run /pardon, they can’t run /unban either.

**How to use**

/shortcutcmnd create "<alias>" as "<target>"
Example: /shortcutcmnd create "unban" as "pardon"

/shortcutcmnd delete|del|remove <alias> – remove a shortcut

/shortcutcmnd list – show all your shortcuts

/shortcutcmnd help – quick guide with examples

Why use it?

- Save time typing commands
— Rename commands to match your server’s style
— Works for both players and console
— Everything is managed in-game
